create_OneDTransitionRewardModel: create a OneDTransitionRewardModel wrapper for a 1-D dynamics model with delta prediction and input normalization
update_normalizer: update the input normalizer statistics using a batch of transition data before training
sample_next_observation: sample next observations and rewards from the 1-D model given an action and model state
eval_score: evaluate the model score over a batch of transitions to assess prediction accuracy
save_and_load_model: save the model and normalizer to disk or load them back from a directory
